sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored - GitHub
sources.snippet: Official Qwen 3.8 27B Q4_K_M (~16.8 GB) + a harvested uncensored SYSTEM pack. GitHub cannot host the weights. Download the GGUF below, or pull the Ollama tag — this repo bakes the residual so ollama run stays uncensored.

sources.title: Qwen 3 VL node for ComfyUI + Qwen 3 VL (Heretic, uncensored) model
sources.snippet: As for "heretic support" it is easy to add heretic model into the available QWEN 3.5 VL node from registry. It is needed to edit the file with the list of models by adding the " someuser/model-name " element into the array of model name in one or two .py files and add a SYSTEM_PROMPT options.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 is Qwen's new model family, featuring Qwen3.8- 27B, Qwen3.8- 2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8- Max.
